mechanism: C1 (pre-pilot measurement only; P.C1 itself stays NOT_AUTHORISED)

approval.scope: bounded measurement of the NOLO-discard branch CPU fraction f: about 10 self-play deals, a few CPU-minutes, timing per decision type

purpose: Estimate f = CPU in C1-eligible decisions / total CPU of the as-is best agent in v3 play, to bound C1's total CPU saving by f*r
policy: tuppi_ai.best.best_agents(worlds=128) at all four seats, B0-installed library (byte-identical to B0-source), fresh agents per deal (independent_cold_bundle)

forced_nolo.contract_selection: scripted: every seat shows its first legal NOLO card (synthetic; bid CPU excluded)
forced_nolo.use: CPU of C1-eligible discards per NOLO deal only

c1_eligible_decision: ruleset v3, ordinary TRICK_PLAY, contract NOLO, actor void in the led suit, >= 2 legal cards
timing: time.process_time around each choose_action (process-wide CPU, all native threads); wall per decision; deal totals

caps.rule: before each deal, stop if spent + mean cost of one deal so far would exceed a cap

analysis: f_natural = ratio of sums over natural deals with a deal-bootstrap interval; c_NOLO = eligible CPU per forced-NOLO deal; f_model = P(NOLO) * c_NOLO / CPU per natural deal over a stated P(NOLO) range; total saving bound f*r for r in {0.1, 0.35, 0.5}
not_claimed: no strength, no C1 variance reduction (r is not measured here), 8 deals cannot give a precise NOLO frequency
